index 0000000..840915d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/ignore_invalid_utf8.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import typing as t
+
+from ._compat import _get_argv_encoding
+from .types import StringParamType
+
+if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from .core import Context
+    from .core import Parameter
+
+
+class IgnoreInvalidUtf8(StringParamType):
+    """Like :class:`~click.types.StringParamType`, but when falling back
+    to UTF-8 decoding of bytes, invalid sequences are dropped instead of
+    replaced.
+    """
+
+    def convert(
+        self, value: t.Any, param: Parameter | None, ctx: Context | None
+    ) -> t.Any:
+        if isinstance(value, bytes):
+            enc = _get_argv_encoding()
+            try:
+                value = value.decode(enc)
+            except UnicodeError:
+                fs_enc = sys.getfilesystemencoding()
+                if fs_enc != enc:
+                    try:
+                        value = value.decode(fs_enc)
+                    except UnicodeError:
+                        value = value.decode("utf-8", "ignore")
+                else:
+                    value = value.decode("utf-8", "ignore")
+            return value
+        return str(value)
notes:
Added IgnoreInvalidUtf8 in src/click/ignore_invalid_utf8.py, overriding convert with StringParamType.convert logic copied verbatim except errors="ignore" in the two final UTF-8 fallbacks; the reference uses no super() calls and has no decorators, so none were added.
